name: Grilled Anguilla Lobster
desc: Spiny lobster grilled over coals with garlic butter, eaten with fingers on a beach. Anguilla's pride. Restores 220 HP.

name: Peas and Rice
desc: Pigeon peas and rice cooked in coconut milk with thyme. The most popular side dish in the Caribbean, and often the main. Restores 150 HP.

name: Tamarind Balls
desc: Sticky tamarind pulp rolled in sugar, sweet and sour in one go. Sold in paper bags by people who know when you need one. Restores 120 HP.

name: Sloop Sail
desc: A triangular mainsail in patched white Dacron. Sloop sails are enormous for the boat, which is the entire point.

name: Crew Plank
desc: A long teak plank, worn smooth by a hundred crews. Anguilla's racing boats have no deck, only a narrow rail and sandbags for ballast, so the crew's business is to sit on it and not to fall off.

name: Race Pennant
desc: A small triangular flag in the colours of a winning sloop, flown from the mast on Anguilla Day. It has seen rum, rain and the occasional protest.
msg: {name}'s Race Pennant cut the tide aside!
